facts.fact: On 6 February 2026 the foreign affairs and social affairs ministers handed biometric passports (refugee travel documents) to a group of ten refugees in Brazzaville, according to ACI.
facts.system: biometric passport (titre de voyage de refugie)

facts.fact: ACI reports that the handover of biometric passports to refugees will continue progressively, under a government partnership with UNHCR.
facts.system: biometric passport (titre de voyage de refugie)
